ownership.quote: Four years ago, my co-founders and I started Together AI because we saw generative AI as a turning point for human progress.

stage.quote: Today, I am excited to announce the next milestone in our journey with Series C funding of $800 million from an incredible group of investors including Aramco Ventures, NVIDIA, Vista Equity, General Catalyst, Emergence Capital, SE Ventures, Pegatron, Salesforce Ventures, March Capital, DTCP Growth, Lux Capital, Geodesic, PSP Partners, and others.
stage.note: This card covers Together's Code Sandbox / Code Interpreter product, which runs on the CodeSandbox platform Together AI acquired in Dec 2024; funding/stage reflect the parent company Together AI, not a separately-funded entity.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of Together AI's own announced rounds: $20M seed + $102.5M Series A + $106M extension + $305M Series B + $800M Series C, all confirmed via together.ai blog posts.

last_round.quote: Series C funding of $800 million from an incredible group of investors including Aramco Ventures, NVIDIA, Vista Equity, General Catalyst, Emergence Capital, SE Ventures, Pegatron, Salesforce Ventures, March Capital, DTCP Growth, Lux Capital, Geodesic, PSP Partners, and others.

note: This card is for Together's Code Sandbox (sales-only, custom-plan Firecracker VMs) and Code Interpreter ($0.03/60-min session) products, built on CodeSandbox, which Together AI acquired in December 2024 (https://www.together.ai/blog/codesandbox-acquisition-together-code-interpreter). All ownership/funding/investor data here is for the parent company, Together AI, not a standalone entity for the sandbox product. Together AI's funding history: $20M seed (Lux Capital, undated on blog), $102.5M Series A (Nov 2023, led by Kleiner Perkins, with NVIDIA and Emergence Capital), $106M extension (Mar 2024, led by Salesforce Ventures), $305M Series B (Feb 2025, led by General Catalyst, co-led by Prosperity7), $800M Series C (Jul 2026). No lead investor was explicitly named for the Series C in Together's own post; no ARR/revenue or employee count was found.
